# Ways to support family and communities affected by flooding in Nepal and China


Go Global


By Western Union


August 28, 2026


Severe flooding has affected communities across Nepal and China, disrupting homes, livelihoods, and daily life. As people begin recovering, support from family, friends, and communities around the world can make a meaningful difference.


Whether you’re helping family members meet immediate needs, checking on their well-being, or contributing to relief efforts, there are many ways to support those affected by this disaster.


## Ways to help after flooding


- Send financial support to family and friends
- Stay connected and check in regularly
- Donate through trusted organizations
- Share reliable information and updates


## Your support makes a difference


Our thoughts are with the people of Nepal and China who are facing the effects of recent flooding. During difficult times, financial support, practical help, and staying connected can help communities recover and rebuild.

## 1. Provide financial support


Natural disasters can disrupt access to essential services and create unexpected expenses. Financial support can help people cover urgent needs, such as food, temporary housing, transportation, medical care, and other necessities.


### Send money online


If you’re looking to support family and friends in Nepal or China, you can[send money online](http://westernunion.com/send-money-start) by[creating a profile](https://www.westernunion.com/us/en/web/user/register) with Western Union. Existing customers can[log in](https://www.westernunion.com/us/en/login) and start sending support from almost anywhere.


Before sending money, you may also wish to check current exchange rates using our[currency converter](https://www.westernunion.com/us/en/currency-converter.html) .


### Use the[Western Union app](https://www.westernunion.com/us/en/mobile-app.html)


Customers who prefer to manage transfers on the go can use the Western Union app to send money, track transactions, and stay connected wherever they are.


### Send money in person


If you prefer to send money in person, you can[find a nearby Western Union location](https://www.westernunion.com/global-services/find-locations) .


Depending on availability in the recipient’s location, various delivery methods may be available to provide flexibility and convenience. Before sending money, it’s a good idea to confirm which receiving options are available in the recipient’s area.


## 2. Offer emotional support


While practical support is important, emotional support can be just as valuable.


Consider reaching out regularly to:


- Check on the safety and well-being of family and friends
- Help coordinate support among family members
- Share trusted local resources and updates
- Offer encouragement as recovery efforts continue


Even brief conversations can provide comfort and reassurance during uncertain times.


## 3. Support recovery efforts


If you’d like to support affected communities more broadly, donating to reputable humanitarian organizations can contribute to emergency response efforts and long-term recovery initiatives.


When donating, always verify that organizations are legitimate and transparent about how contributions are used.


Examples of internationally recognized humanitarian organizations include:


- [The International Federation of Red Cross](https://www.ifrc.org/)
- [The Nepal Red Cross Society](https://nrcs.org/)
- [Red Cross Society of China](http://www.redcross.org.cn/)
- [UNICEF](https://www.unicef.org/)
- [World Vision](https://www.worldvision.org/)
- [Save the Children](https://www.savethechildren.org/)


Visit each organization’s official website to learn more about ongoing flood-relief and recovery initiatives and ways to support affected communities.


## 4. Share trusted information


In the aftermath of a disaster, misinformation can spread quickly. Be sure to rely on trusted sources for updates, safety guidance, and emergency response information, and encourage family and friends to do the same.


Sharing verified information can help communities stay informed and make decisions based on accurate guidance.


## Standing together during recovery


Flooding can create lasting challenges for families and communities, but support from relatives, friends, neighbors, and people around the world can help people move forward.


Whether you’re providing financial support, offering encouragement, or contributing to trusted relief efforts, every act of kindness can make a difference.


When communities face difficult times, staying connected remains one of the most powerful ways to show support.
